neighbours.label: the token before an alternative name or title for something just mentioned (', better known as', ', as it was then known', 'given the name')
fire: The novel is by Eric Blair, better known as George Orwell.
The pilot trained at Clark Field, as it was then known, before the war.
The singer Stefani Germanotta, better known as Lady Gaga, grew up in New York.
The young man was given the name Tenzin by his teachers at the monastery.
Istanbul, or Constantinople as it was then called, fell in 1453.
His fierce temper earned him the nickname Stonewall among his troops.
The town of Kingston, as it was then known, grew quickly after 1790.
The puzzle was given the name Rubik's Cube when it was sold abroad.
quiet: The novel is by Eric Blair, an Englishman who was born in India.
The pilot trained at Clark Field, a large base, before the war.
The singer Stefani Germanotta, who has won many awards, grew up in New York.
The young man was given a bowl of rice by his teachers at the monastery.
Istanbul, a city on the Bosphorus, fell in 1453.
His fierce temper earned him a reprimand from his officers.
The town of Kingston, which lies on the coast, grew quickly after 1790.
The puzzle was given a bright new box when it was sold abroad.

notes: Probes: ' better' 0.59, ' as' 0.51, 'given the' 0.37. 'Also known as' and 'by the name' were weak in short sentences (0.10-0.15). The - pole is affix and substring handling in code, plausibly the other side only in a loose way.
